title: The Tree of Life
lead: A tree in Eden whose fruit gives unending life (Genesis 2:9; 3:22–24). Wisdom is called a tree of life (Proverbs 3:18), Ezekiel sees healing trees by the river from the temple (Ezekiel 47:12), and in Revelation the tree of life grows by the river of the new Jerusalem, its leaves for the healing of the nations (Revelation 22:2).
